changes.change: Added an explicit acquisition presentation contract separating PQ→skill association from guaranteed rewards, Ultimate Finish requirements, enemy-specific triggers, and drop probabilities. Unknown/unresolved/partially_verified research states must remain visible.

validated_repository_rules: A canonical pq_rewards_skill relationship establishes association, not guarantee semantics.
Ultimate Finish requirements must be independently evidenced.
Guaranteed should be reserved for deterministic or explicitly verified rewards.
Research uncertainty must not be silently promoted into canonical acquisition mechanics.
next_priority: Continue the high-volume skill consumer census and then safely refresh stale canonical skill metadata in bounded batches without reconstructing large generated files from truncated responses.
